title: The Macro‐Economic Effects of a European Deposit (Re‐)Insurance Scheme
title_zh: 欧洲存款（再）保险计划的宏观经济效应
title_primary: 欧洲存款（再）保险计划的宏观经济效应
title_secondary: The Macro‐Economic Effects of a European Deposit (Re‐)Insurance Scheme
authors: MARIUS CLEMENS, STEFAN GEBAUER, TOBIAS KÖNIG
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Recent proposals for a European deposit insurance scheme (EDIS) favor a reinsurance framework. In this paper, we use a regime‐switching open‐economy DSGE model with bank defaults to assess the relative efficiency of such a scheme. We find that reinsurance by EDIS is more effective in stabilizing real activity, credit, and welfare than a national fiscal backstop. We demonstrate that risk‐weighted contributions to EDIS are welfare‐beneficial for depositors and discuss trade‐offs policymakers face during the implementation of EDIS. We also find that macroprudential regulation and EDIS can complement each other and that EDIS can prevent bank runs under certain conditions.
abstract_zh: 近期关于欧洲存款保险计划（EDIS）的提案倾向于采用再保险框架。本文运用一个包含银行违约的体制转换开放经济DSGE模型，评估此类计划的相对效率。我们发现，相较于国家财政后盾，EDIS的再保险机制在稳定实际经济活动、信贷及福利方面更为有效。我们证明，向EDIS缴纳风险加权贡献金对储户福利有益，并探讨了政策制定者在实施EDIS过程中面临的权衡取舍。我们还发现，宏观审慎监管与EDIS能够相辅相成，且在特定条件下，EDIS可防止银行挤兑。

title: The intergenerational effect of the Food Stamp Program on marriage and fertility
title_zh: 食品券计划对婚姻与生育的代际影响
title_primary: 食品券计划对婚姻与生育的代际影响
title_secondary: The intergenerational effect of the Food Stamp Program on marriage and fertility
authors: Augustine Denteh, Nicardo McInnis
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the intergenerational effects of the Food Stamp Program (FSP) on fertility and marriage in the United States. Using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we leverage the initial roll-out of the Food Stamp Program in the 1960s and 1970s to examine the future family formation decisions of individuals born between 1955 and 1981. The results suggest that exposure to the program has different effects on fertility and marriage based on age and gender. For men, increased exposure to the program reduces fertility at older ages, particularly for those from disadvantaged backgrounds, with limited effects on marriage. Among women, we find no statistically significant effects of increased exposure to FSP on fertility and marriage. Our study builds on a growing literature that considers the intergenerational impacts of public policies that increase childhood economic resources.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国食品券计划（FSP）对生育与婚姻的代际影响。利用收入动态面板研究数据，我们借助20世纪60年代和70年代食品券计划的初始推行，探讨了1955年至1981年间出生个体未来的家庭组建决策。结果表明，该计划的暴露程度对生育和婚姻的影响因年龄和性别而异。对于男性而言，增加计划暴露会降低其较大年龄时的生育率，尤其是对来自不利背景的男性，而对婚姻的影响有限。在女性中，我们发现增加FSP暴露对生育和婚姻无统计学上显著的影响。本研究丰富了日益增长的文献，这些文献关注增加童年经济资源的公共政策所产生的代际影响。

title: Industrial policy in complementary markets: Lessons from India's 4G rollout
title_zh: 互补市场中的产业政策：来自印度4G推广的经验教训
title_primary: 互补市场中的产业政策：来自印度4G推广的经验教训
title_secondary: Industrial policy in complementary markets: Lessons from India's 4G rollout
authors: Chirantan Chatterjee, Ying Fan, Debi Prasad Mohapatra
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Governments increasingly use protection and targeted subsidies to promote domestic firms. These policies are usually evaluated in the market they target. This column uses India's 4G rollout to show why that can be misleading when products and infrastructure are complements. Restricting low-priced Chinese phones slowed 4G network expansion and did not raise Indian phone firms' profits, while a subsidy open to all 4G phones accelerated coverage more than a domestic-only subsidy.
abstract_zh: 各国政府日益采用保护措施和定向补贴来扶持本土企业。这些政策通常在所针对的市场中进行评估。本文利用印度4G网络的推广案例，说明当产品与基础设施为互补品时，此类评估可能产生误导。限制低价中国手机减缓了4G网络的扩展，且并未提升印度手机企业的利润，而面向所有4G手机的补贴在加速网络覆盖方面，效果优于仅限本土企业的补贴。

title: A Comment on “The Heterogeneous Tax Pass-Through Under Different Vertical Relationships” by Bajo-Buenestado and Borrella-Mas
title_zh: 对巴霍-布埃内斯塔多与博雷利亚-马斯《不同纵向关系下的异质性税收转嫁》一文的评论
title_primary: 对巴霍-布埃内斯塔多与博雷利亚-马斯《不同纵向关系下的异质性税收转嫁》一文的评论
title_secondary: A Comment on “The Heterogeneous Tax Pass-Through Under Different Vertical Relationships” by Bajo-Buenestado and Borrella-Mas
authors: Ismail El Fassi, Saleh Zakerinia
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We revisit the heterogeneous tax pass-through analysis in Borrella-Mas (2022a) (B&B). We find that B&B’s estimating equation is misspecified, as it excludes a necessary lower-order interaction between vertical integration and the post-treatment period. Including this term reveals a significant structural price trend for vertically integrated firms in the post-reform period, whose origin is uncertain. A spatial placebo test confirms that this structural shift is present even in never-treated provinces, indicating that it is not a local, province-level pass-through of the regional tax. Without this control, the original specification may conflate this shift with the tax effect. Once the interaction is included, the differential pass-through estimate becomes null for diesel, while for gasoline a significant effect persists—albeit at a reduced magnitude—supporting B&B’s central claim that market structure matters for tax pass-through. These findings highlight the importance of explicitly modelling group-specific time trends when estimating heterogeneous treatment effects in difference-in-differences designs.
abstract_zh: 我们重新审视了Borrella-Mas (2022a)（简称B&B）中的异质性税收转嫁分析。我们发现B&B的估计方程设定有误，因为它遗漏了垂直整合与处理后时期之间必要的低阶交互项。纳入这一项后，揭示了改革后时期垂直整合企业显著的结构性价格趋势，其来源尚不确定。空间安慰剂检验证实，即使在从未受处理的省份也存在这种结构性转变，表明这并非地方性的省级税收转嫁效应。若无此控制，原始设定可能将这一转变与税收效应混淆。一旦加入交互项，柴油的差异化转嫁估计变为零，而汽油则仍存在显著效应——尽管幅度有所减小——这支持了B&B的核心主张，即市场结构对税收转嫁具有重要影响。这些发现强调了在双重差分设计中估计异质性处理效应时，明确建模组别特定时间趋势的重要性。

title: Immigrant Earnings Assimilation, 1981–2021
title_zh: 移民收入同化，1981-2021年
title_primary: 移民收入同化，1981-2021年
title_secondary: Immigrant Earnings Assimilation, 1981–2021
authors: Randall Akee, Jimmy Chin, Daniel L. Crown
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper, we characterize trends in the earnings assimilation of immigrant workers from 1981 to 2021. We use administrative longitudinal data that contain the earnings of workers beginning in their first year of residence in the United States and in each year thereafter, allowing us to identify immigrants who eventually leave the United States (referred to here as return migrants). We use those data to produce the first examination of trends in earnings assimilation over a 41-year period and to estimate earnings assimilation separately for return migrants versus those who stay in the United States. We document several new facts about immigrants who arrived between 1981 to 2010. First, roughly one-fifth to one-third of immigrants return migrate from the United States within 10 years after arrival. Second, return migrants have entry earnings similar to those of permanent migrants but experience slower rates of earnings growth. Third, earnings assimilation occurs relatively quickly for cohorts arriving since the mid-1990s: The earnings of permanent immigrants converge, or come close to converging, with those of native-born people within 10 years after arrival. Migrants from earlier arrival cohorts experience significant earnings growth but generally do not converge to that of the native born. We discuss how changes in the labor market quality of immigrant cohorts (measured by their relative earnings upon entry) and selective return migration play an important role in determining whether repeated cross-sectional data over- or underestimate earnings assimilation.
abstract_zh: 本文刻画了1981年至2021年间移民工人收入同化的趋势。我们利用行政纵向数据，这些数据记录了工人在美国居住第一年及之后每年的收入，从而能够识别最终离开美国的移民（此处称为回流移民）。借助这些数据，我们首次对长达41年间的收入同化趋势进行了考察，并分别估算了回流移民与留美移民的收入同化情况。我们记录了1981年至2010年间抵达美国的移民的几个新事实。第一，大约五分之一至三分之一的移民在抵达后10年内从美国回流。第二，回流移民的初始收入与永久移民相似，但其收入增长速度较慢。第三，自1990年代中期以来抵达的移民群体，其收入同化发生得相对较快：永久移民的收入在抵达后10年内与本土出生人群的收入趋同或接近趋同。而更早抵达的移民群体虽经历了显著的收入增长，但总体上并未与本土出生人群的收入趋同。我们讨论了移民群体劳动力市场质量的变化（以其入境时的相对收入衡量）以及选择性回流移民，在决定重复横截面数据是高估还是低估收入同化方面所起的重要作用。

title: Incentive-Compatible Critical Values
title_zh: 激励相容的临界值
title_primary: 激励相容的临界值
title_secondary: Incentive-Compatible Critical Values
authors: Adam McCloskey, Pascal Michaillat
official: 官方在线 2022-01-21 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Statistically significant results are more rewarded than insignificant ones, so researchers have the incentive to pursue statistical significance. Such p-hacking reduces the informativeness of hypothesis tests by making significant results much more common than they are supposed to be in the absence of true significance. To address this problem, we construct critical values of test statistics such that, if these values are used to determine significance, and if researchers optimally respond to these new significance standards, then significant results occur with the desired frequency. Such incentive-compatible critical values allow for p-hacking so they are larger than classical critical values. Using evidence from the social and medical sciences, we find that the incentive-compatible critical value for any test and any significance level is the classical critical value for the same test with approximately one fifth of the significance level-a form of Bonferroni correction. For instance, for a z-test with a significance level of 5%, the incentivecompatible critical value is 2.31 instead of 1.65 if the test is one-sided and 2.57 instead of 1.96 if the test is two-sided.
abstract_zh: 统计上显著的结果比不显著的结果获得更多奖励，因此研究者有动机追求统计显著性。这种p-hacking行为使得显著结果远比在无真实效应时应出现的频率更为常见，从而降低了假设检验的信息量。为解决这一问题，我们构建了检验统计量的临界值，使得若采用这些值判定显著性，且研究者对这些新显著性标准作出最优反应，则显著结果将以期望频率出现。这种激励相容的临界值允许p-hacking存在，因此它们大于经典临界值。利用社会科学和医学领域的证据，我们发现，对于任何检验和任何显著性水平，激励相容的临界值等同于同一检验在约五分之一显著性水平下的经典临界值——这是一种Bonferroni校正形式。例如，对于显著性水平为5%的z检验，若为单侧检验，激励相容的临界值为2.31而非1.65；若为双侧检验，则为2.57而非1.96。

title: The Economics of Civil Service Protections
title_zh: 公务员保护的经济学
title_primary: 公务员保护的经济学
title_secondary: The Economics of Civil Service Protections
authors: Guo Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The study of bureaucracy as a key dimension of state capacity has gained increasing attention in economics. What organizational features create an effective bureaucracy, however, remains subject to debate. This paper focuses on the central role of civil service protections in delineating the boundary between politics and administration. I introduce a simple principal-agent framework to discuss the key theoretical channels through which political insulation can shape bureaucrat performance. Guided by the framework, I establish stylized facts and organize evidence from historical and contemporary civil service reforms. Overall, the micro-level evidence documents a positive effect of civil service protections on the quality of public service delivery. I conclude with open questions about the political economy of reform adoption.
abstract_zh: 官僚制作为国家能力的关键维度，其研究在经济学中日益受到关注。然而，何种组织特征能造就有效的官僚体系，仍是争论焦点。本文聚焦于公务员保护在界定政治与行政边界中的核心作用。我引入一个简洁的委托-代理框架，探讨政治隔离影响官僚绩效的主要理论渠道。在此框架指导下，我确立了若干典型事实，并系统整理了历史及当代公务员制度改革的相关证据。总体而言，微观层面的证据表明，公务员保护对公共服务供给质量具有积极影响。最后，我提出关于改革采纳的政治经济学未解问题。

abstract: //static.cambridge.org/content/id/urn%3Acambridge.org%3Aid%3Aarticle%3AS0022109026103305/resource/name/firstPage-pdf-S0022109026103305a.jpg
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个独特的自然实验，考察了在2008年金融危机期间，美国财政部对房利美和房地美（两房）的接管如何影响其子公司发行的机构债券的信用利差。通过事件研究法，我们发现接管公告显著降低了机构债券的信用利差，且这一效应在期限较长的债券中更为明显。进一步分析表明，信用利差的下降主要归因于政府隐性担保的增强，而非流动性改善。我们的研究为政府干预在危机期间稳定金融市场的作用提供了新的证据。

title: Global conservation imaginaries and local realities: Rethinking community-based natural resources management in Northeast Madagascar
title_zh: 全球保护想象与地方现实：重新思考马达加斯加东北部基于社区的自然资源管理
title_primary: 全球保护想象与地方现实：重新思考马达加斯加东北部基于社区的自然资源管理
title_secondary: Global conservation imaginaries and local realities: Rethinking community-based natural resources management in Northeast Madagascar
authors: Jane Slentz-Kesler, William G. Moseley, Sandolin Raharinirina, Xavier Haro-Carrión
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates the dynamics of a community-based protected area management system in northeast Madagascar, addressing three key questions: What is the relationship between local livelihoods and the protected area? How do the management system’s use zones compare to forest cover dynamics on the ground? How could the forest management system be reformed to better support both local communities and forest ecosystems? We employ a mixed-methods approach, combining interviews and focus groups with local residents, a PlanetScope-based land cover classification, and a review of existing documentation. We find that the forest is important for rural livelihoods, yet the management system does not offer sufficient economic benefits to counteract the drivers of land cover change. These drivers include logging as a poverty alleviation strategy, forest clearing for vanilla cultivation, and the farming of staple food crops. While forest management is based on a biosphere model with different forest use zones, it does not reflect realities on the ground. Moving forward, initiatives must address internal and external drivers of forest cover change. Locally, the management model needs to better reflect present land cover, promote alternatives to forest use, and deliver concrete benefits to those who engage in forest conservation. The local community is open to stronger forest preservation, provided it is accompanied by a significant livelihood-supporting benefit. Regionally, strategies are needed to restrict land use by outsiders who often encroach on the forest to cultivate vanilla or harvest timber, and to strengthen coordination across local, regional, and national scales of forest governance.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了马达加斯加东北部社区型保护区管理系统的动态变化，围绕三个核心问题展开：当地生计与保护区之间存在何种关联？管理系统的功能分区与地面森林覆盖动态相比如何？森林管理系统应如何改革，以更好地兼顾当地社区与森林生态系统的需求？我们采用混合研究方法，结合当地居民的访谈与焦点小组讨论、基于PlanetScope影像的土地覆盖分类，以及现有文献资料的梳理。研究发现，森林对农村生计至关重要，然而现行管理系统未能提供足够的经济利益，以抵消土地覆盖变化的驱动因素。这些驱动因素包括作为减贫策略的伐木活动、为种植香草而进行的森林开垦，以及主粮作物的耕作。尽管森林管理基于生物圈模型并划分了不同的森林利用区域，但该模型并未反映实地真实情况。展望未来，相关举措必须应对森林覆盖变化的内外部驱动因素。在地方层面，管理模型需更贴合当前土地覆盖现状，推广森林利用的替代方案，并为参与森林保护的人员提供切实利益。当地社区愿意接受更严格的森林保护，前提是伴随显著的生计支持性收益。在区域层面，需制定策略限制外来者侵占森林用于香草种植或木材采伐的行为，并加强地方、区域及国家各级森林治理的协调联动。

title: Medical Spending Risk among Older Households by Race
title_zh: 不同种族老年家庭医疗支出风险研究
title_primary: 不同种族老年家庭医疗支出风险研究
title_secondary: Medical Spending Risk among Older Households by Race
authors: Arapakis, Karolos, French, Eric, Jones, John Bailey, McCauley, Jeremy, French, Eric Baird
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We document racial disparities in total and out-of-pocket medical expenditures, using data from the Health and Retirement Study linked to Medicare and Medicaid records. While White, Black, and Hispanic households have similar total annual medical expenditures, minorities benefit from higher Medicaid recipiency and face lower out-of-pocket spending. At age 65, White, Black, and Hispanic households incur on average $136,000, $59,000, and $68,000, respectively, in out-of-pocket medical spending over the remainders of their lives. We use our model to evaluate a policy reform that expands public nursing home insurance. Given that White households currently pay the most out-of-pocket, they have the most to gain from the reform. In the absence of a highly redistributive funding scheme, this reform will on average redistribute financial resources from minorities to White households, illustrating how expanding public insurance can have unintended distributional consequences.
abstract_zh: 我们利用健康与退休研究数据，结合医疗保险和医疗补助记录，记录了总医疗支出及自付医疗支出中的种族差异。尽管白人、黑人和西班牙裔家庭在年度总医疗支出上相近，但少数族裔受益于更高的医疗补助覆盖率，自付支出较低。在65岁时，白人、黑人和西班牙裔家庭在余生中平均分别承担136,000美元、59,000美元和68,000美元的自付医疗费用。我们运用模型评估了一项扩大公共养老院保险的政策改革。鉴于目前白人家庭自付支出最高，他们从改革中获益最多。在没有高度再分配性质的筹资机制下，这项改革平均而言会将财政资源从少数族裔转移至白人家庭，这说明了扩大公共保险可能带来意想不到的分配后果。

title: Monitoring the Monitors: Amakudari and the Ex-Post Monitoring of Private Banks
title_zh: 监督监督者：官员下凡与私营银行的事后监督
title_primary: 监督监督者：官员下凡与私营银行的事后监督
title_secondary: Monitoring the Monitors: Amakudari and the Ex-Post Monitoring of Private Banks
authors: Adrian van Rixtel, Wolter Hassink
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The paper investigates whether the Japanese monetary authorities use post-retirement employment of Ministry of Finance (MoF) and Bank of Japan (BoJ) officials as a policy instrument. The authors also investigate whether industrial groupings (keiretsu) and main banks have monitoring functions. They find that MoF and BoJ retirees do move into banks that perform badly in terms of profitability. Furthermore, the paper concludes that the movement of these retirees into the boards of private banks is positively related to specific main bank relationships. The hypothesis of monitoring by keiretsu is rejected, however. Finally, the paper finds that MoF/BoJ amakudari appointments have a positive impact on the development of lending to risky industries. In particular, this latter finding casts doubts on the credibility of the hypothesis that amakudari is used as an instrument of prudential policy.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了日本货币当局是否将财务省和日本银行官员的退休后任职作为一种政策工具。作者还研究了企业集团和主银行是否具有监督功能。他们发现，财务省和日本银行的退休人员确实会进入那些盈利能力较差的银行。此外，本文得出结论，这些退休人员进入私人银行董事会的流动与特定的主银行关系呈正相关。然而，企业集团监督的假设被否定。最后，本文发现，财务省或日本银行的“空降”任命对向高风险行业发放贷款具有积极影响。特别是，这一发现对“空降”被用作审慎政策工具的假设的可信度提出了质疑。

title: How oil price shocks redraw the map of conflict
title_zh: 油价冲击如何重塑冲突版图
title_primary: 油价冲击如何重塑冲突版图
title_secondary: How oil price shocks redraw the map of conflict
authors: Maximilian Herrmann, Jingke Pan, Axel Dreher
official: 官方在线 2026-07-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Oil price shocks do not simply make conflict more likely everywhere; they change where violence happens. Using monthly georeferenced data for 131 low- and middle-income countries from 1989 to 2021, this column shows that higher oil prices pull organised conflict towards petroleum fields, while protests and attacks rise around refineries and pipelines. Aggregate conflict statistics can therefore look calm while the local map of violence is being redrawn.
abstract_zh: 油价冲击并非简单地使冲突在全球范围内更易发生，而是改变了暴力事件的发生地点。本文利用1989年至2021年间131个低收入和中等收入国家的月度地理参考数据表明，油价上涨会将有组织冲突引向油田区域，同时炼油厂和管道周边的抗议与袭击事件也会增加。因此，当局部暴力地图正在被重新绘制时，总体冲突统计数据可能看似平静。

title: AI, the future of economic research and of the many-handed economist
title_zh: 人工智能：经济研究与多面手经济学家的未来
title_primary: 人工智能：经济研究与多面手经济学家的未来
title_secondary: AI, the future of economic research and of the many-handed economist
authors: Beatrice Weder di Mauro
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Globalisation has changed economic research profoundly, making it more comparable, more competitive, and thoroughly quantitative. This column argues that AI may unsettle this new order as thoroughly as globalisation unsettled the old one and discusses the technical and geopolitical mechanisms at work. One prediction can be made with high confidence: someone who wakes up thirty years from now is likely to recognise economics as little as someone who fell asleep thirty years ago and just woke up today.
abstract_zh: 全球化深刻改变了经济学研究，使其更具可比性、竞争性，并彻底走向定量化。本专栏认为，人工智能可能像当年全球化颠覆旧秩序一样，彻底动摇这一新格局，并探讨了其中涉及的技术与地缘政治机制。一个高度可信的预测是：三十年后醒来的人，很可能像三十年前入睡、今天才醒来的人一样，几乎认不出经济学这门学科。

title: Scars of War: The Legacy of WWI Deaths on Civic Capital and Combat Motivation
title_zh: 战争伤痕：一战死亡对公民资本与战斗动机的遗留影响
title_primary: 战争伤痕：一战死亡对公民资本与战斗动机的遗留影响
title_secondary: Scars of War: The Legacy of WWI Deaths on Civic Capital and Combat Motivation
authors: Carozzi, Felipe, Pinchbeck, Edward, Repetto, Luca
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study how the legacy of WWI deaths affected British communities and the next generation of soldiers. Our instrumental-variable estimates show that servicemen from localities that suffered heavier losses in WWI were considerably more likely to die or win gallantry medals in WW2. To contextualise these findings, we show that the mortality shock increased communities’ inter-war civic capital as demonstrated by the creation of war memorials, veterans’ associations and charities, and increases in pro-social participation. Our results highlight the importance of past conflicts in fostering pro-social behaviours which, in turn, can shape the motivation of soldiers in future wars.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一战死亡遗留问题如何影响英国社区及下一代士兵。工具变量估计表明，来自一战损失更惨重地区的军人在二战中阵亡或获得英勇勋章的可能性显著更高。为阐释这些发现，我们证明死亡率冲击通过战争纪念碑、退伍军人协会和慈善机构的建立，以及亲社会参与度的提升，增强了社区在两次世界大战间的公民资本。研究结果凸显了过往冲突在培育亲社会行为中的重要性，而这种行为反过来可能塑造未来战争中士兵的动机。

title: Daughters like mothers? New evidence of inter-generational transmission of labor market stereotypical behavior
title_zh: 女儿像母亲？劳动力市场刻板行为代际传递的新证据
title_primary: 女儿像母亲？劳动力市场刻板行为代际传递的新证据
title_secondary: Daughters like mothers? New evidence of inter-generational transmission of labor market stereotypical behavior
authors: Aukje Nieuwenhuis, Agnieszka Postepska
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Recent literature provides evidence of inter-generational correlation regarding gender-stereotypical behavior in the labor market. There are two potential explanations for this pattern: selection and causality. Relying on identification through second moments, we reveal a striking result among female adolescents in Germany and Australia. The apparent positive correlation between mothers and daughters is entirely driven by selection, suggesting that sticky gender norms are responsible for persistent gender segregation in the labor market. Most surprisingly, we find that causality operates in the opposite direction, suggesting that the mother holding a non-stereotypical job may have an ambiguous effect on the daughter’s occupational choice. Our findings have important implications for policymakers and identify new directions for future research. We highlight the need to investigate the mechanisms of transmission further to design policies that are successful at closing the remaining gaps. Our findings also suggest that policies designed to foster balanced gender compositions may fall short of achieving the desired inter-generational spillovers unless fundamental shifts in underlying gender norms occur.
abstract_zh: 近期文献提供了劳动力市场中性别刻板行为代际相关性的证据。这一现象存在两种可能的解释：选择效应与因果效应。通过利用二阶矩识别方法，我们在德国和澳大利亚的女性青少年中揭示了一个惊人结果：母女之间看似正向的相关性完全由选择效应驱动，这表明僵化的性别规范是导致劳动力市场持续性别隔离的根源。最令人意外的是，我们发现因果效应呈现反向作用——母亲从事非刻板职业可能对女儿的择业产生模糊影响。本研究对政策制定具有重要启示，并为未来研究指明了新方向。我们强调需进一步探究传导机制，以设计能有效弥合现存性别差距的政策。研究同时表明，除非根本性转变潜在性别规范，否则旨在促进性别平衡构成的政策可能难以实现预期的代际溢出效应。

title: Credit Expansion in the Caucasus and Central Asia
title_zh: 高加索和中亚地区的信贷扩张
title_primary: 高加索和中亚地区的信贷扩张
title_secondary: Credit Expansion in the Caucasus and Central Asia
authors: Mr. Etibar Jafarov & Chingis Matayev
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes credit developments in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) using several complementary approaches. First, it estimates long-run equilibrium credit levels based on economic fundamentals, providing benchmarks to assess whether observed credit levels are broadly aligned with country characteristics. Second, it applies statistical “gap” measures to identify periods of unusually rapid credit expansion that may signal emerging financial vulnerabilities. Third, it uses the Kalman filter to decompose credit into trend and cyclical elements conditional on macro variables. The results suggest there is scope for further financial deepening in all CCA economies, but the speed of household credit expansion warrants close monitoring. A comparative “horse race” of alternative indicators suggests that no single measure consistently outperforms others across countries, implying that combining various credit gap measures enhances the robustness of risk assessments.
abstract_zh: 本文采用多种互补方法分析高加索和中亚地区的信贷发展。首先，基于经济基本面估算长期均衡信贷水平，为评估实际信贷水平是否与各国特征基本一致提供基准。其次，运用统计"缺口"指标识别可能预示金融脆弱性出现的异常快速信贷扩张期。第三，利用卡尔曼滤波法将信贷分解为趋势成分与周期成分，并使其以宏观变量为条件。研究结果表明，所有高加索和中亚经济体均存在进一步深化金融的空间，但家庭信贷扩张速度需密切监测。通过比较不同指标的"赛马"分析发现，没有任何单一指标能在各国间持续优于其他指标，这意味着综合运用多种信贷缺口指标可增强风险评估的稳健性。

title: Ruth, Anthony, and Clarence
title_zh: 《露丝、安东尼与克拉伦斯》
title_primary: 《露丝、安东尼与克拉伦斯》
title_secondary: Ruth, Anthony, and Clarence
authors: Jeffrey C. Ely
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Nonpartisan voters can become polarized not because of ideology but because it is optimal for them to remain uninformed and cancel out the votes of uninformed voters on “the other side.” Indeed, when stuck in such a state of polarization, it is socially optimal to do so. Dynamics can lead an otherwise well‐functioning assembly into irreversible polarization. Reputation effects might only make things worse.
abstract_zh: 无党派选民之所以可能走向极化，并非源于意识形态，而是因为保持信息闭塞、抵消"另一方"信息闭塞选民的选票对其而言是最优选择。事实上，当陷入这种极化状态时，从社会整体来看这样做也是最优的。动态演化可能导致原本运作良好的议会陷入不可逆转的极化。声誉效应可能只会使情况进一步恶化。

title: Air Pollution and Early Childhood Outcomes: Evidence from Georgia Childcare Providers
title_zh: 空气污染与儿童早期发展结果：来自佐治亚州儿童保育机构的证据
title_primary: 空气污染与儿童早期发展结果：来自佐治亚州儿童保育机构的证据
title_secondary: Air Pollution and Early Childhood Outcomes: Evidence from Georgia Childcare Providers
authors: Mahta Ghafarianghadim, Garth Heutel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Many effects of pollution exposure on health and education outcomes of children have been identified, but little is known about education effects on preschool-aged children. We estimate the effect of particulate matter air pollution on preschool attendance using restricted administrative data from the state of Georgia. We use thermal inversions, weather phenomena that trap pollutants, as an instrumental variable for pollution. A one-unit increase in the county-week average ambient particulate pollution level decreases attendance by around 2 percentage points. Effects seem to be larger for racial minorities and for children with working parents.
abstract_zh: 已有研究证实污染暴露对儿童健康与教育成果的多重影响，但关于污染对学龄前儿童教育的影响仍知之甚少。本研究利用佐治亚州的受限行政数据，评估颗粒物空气污染对学前教育出勤率的影响。我们采用热逆温现象（一种滞留污染物的天气现象）作为污染的工具变量。结果显示，县级周均环境颗粒物污染水平每增加一个单位，出勤率下降约2个百分点。该效应在少数族裔儿童及父母双职工家庭中更为显著。

title: Decoding Fiscal Messaging: How G7 Finance Ministries Communicate
title_zh: 解码财政信息：七国集团财政部如何沟通
title_primary: 解码财政信息：七国集团财政部如何沟通
title_secondary: Decoding Fiscal Messaging: How G7 Finance Ministries Communicate
authors: Tatiana Evdokimova & Patrick A. Imam
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Fiscal policy has re-emerged as a central tool of macroeconomic stabilization, yet the way governments communicate fiscal choices remains poorly understood. This paper provides the first systematic analysis of fiscal communication across the G7 from 2000–2024. Using a new dataset of budget documents, ministerial speeches, and press communiqués, we examine the clarity, thematic content, and rhetorical tone of official fiscal statements through computational text-analysis methods. We uncover a structured but fragmented communication architecture. Technical documents emphasize sustainability and constraints; speeches underscore growth, fairness, and investment; and press releases distill policy packages into succinct signals. Despite rising expectations of transparency, fiscal language remains complex and often optimistically framed. These patterns reflect institutional design, political incentives, and macroeconomic conditions. Our findings highlight fiscal communication as an underappreciated dimension of economic governance, one that shapes expectations, conditions credibility, and warrants deeper integration into fiscal policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 财政政策已重新成为宏观经济稳定的核心工具，然而政府沟通财政选择的方式仍鲜为人知。本文首次对2000-2024年间七国集团的财政沟通进行了系统性分析。通过运用预算文件、部长演讲和新闻公报的新数据集，我们采用计算文本分析方法，考察了官方财政声明的清晰度、主题内容和修辞语气。研究发现了一种结构化但碎片化的沟通架构：技术文件强调可持续性与约束条件；演讲侧重增长、公平与投资；新闻公报则将政策方案提炼为简洁信号。尽管透明度预期不断提升，财政语言仍保持复杂且常带有乐观倾向。这些模式反映了制度设计、政治激励和宏观经济状况的影响。我们的研究凸显了财政沟通作为经济治理中未被充分重视的维度——它塑造预期、影响可信度，并值得更深入地融入财政政策分析。

title: The Value of One Office Day a Month
title_zh: 每月一天办公室办公的价值
title_primary: 每月一天办公室办公的价值
title_secondary: The Value of One Office Day a Month
authors: Cevat Giray Aksoy, Nicholas Bloom, Steven J. Davis, Victoria Marino, Cem Ozguzel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Remote work has expanded rapidly, but the value of regular in-person contact remains unclear. We report a randomized controlled trial in which a large multinational randomly assigned 248 customer-service employees to remain fully remote or to work at the office together one day a month. Monthly office days gradually increased productivity, with treated employees handling 7.8% more calls per hour in the post-intervention period. Office days also strengthened workplace communication: treated employees spent 36 additional minutes communicating with colleagues in the week after an office visit, were more likely to report receiving manager feedback, and employee pairs randomly assigned as desk neighbors were 11 percentage points more likely to communicate afterward. In addition, monthly office days reduced attrition by a third. The resulting gains in productivity and retention generated a benefit–cost ratio of about 5:1. These findings show that limited, coordinated in-person contact can improve communication, performance, and retention in remote teams.
abstract_zh: 远程工作迅速普及，但定期面对面接触的价值仍不明确。我们报告了一项随机对照试验，一家大型跨国企业将248名客服员工随机分配为完全远程办公或每月有一天共同到办公室工作。每月办公室工作日逐渐提高了生产率，在干预后阶段，受处理员工每小时处理的电话数量增加了7.8%。办公室工作日还加强了职场沟通：受处理员工在办公室访问后一周内与同事的沟通时间增加了36分钟，更有可能报告收到管理者的反馈，且被随机分配为相邻工位的员工在之后沟通的可能性提高了11个百分点。此外，每月办公室工作日将员工流失率降低了三分之一。由此带来的生产率和留任率提升产生了约5:1的收益成本比。这些发现表明，有限且协调的面对面接触能够改善远程团队的沟通、绩效和留任率。

title: Financial Well-being and Inclusion of Justice Involved Populations: Evidence from the SHED
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_primary: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_secondary: Financial Well-being and Inclusion of Justice Involved Populations: Evidence from the SHED
authors: Kabir Dasgupta, Jennifer Fernandez, Alicia Lloro
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study examines financial challenges faced by justice-involved individuals using 2023-2024 Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking data. Individuals with justice system contact experience substantially worse financial outcomes than those without criminal records, with disparities widening by severity of involvement. Compared to individuals with no prior records, those arrested but not convicted are 4 percentage points less likely to report doing at least okay financially, while formerly convicted as well as incarcerated adults are 15 percentage points less likely. Formerly incarcerated individuals are also 21 percentage points less likely to have credit scores above 660 and 13 percentage points less likely to have credit cards. These disparities mirror patterns observed across education levels, where adults with lower educational attainment experience lower financial well-being and inclusion. Our findings document substantial barriers to financial stability among justice-involved populations and may inform policies promoting financial inclusion and improving economic outcomes for this group.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2023-2024年美国家庭经济与决策调查数据，考察了涉法个体面临的金融挑战。与无犯罪记录者相比，有司法系统接触经历的个体在财务结果上显著更差，且差距随涉法程度加深而扩大。相较于无前科者，曾被逮捕但未被定罪者报告财务状况至少尚可的概率低4个百分点，而曾被定罪及监禁的成年人则低15个百分点。曾被监禁者信用评分超过660分的概率低21个百分点，持有信用卡的概率低13个百分点。这些差异与不同教育水平群体中观察到的模式一致——受教育程度较低的成年人财务福祉与金融包容性更低。研究结果揭示了涉法群体在金融稳定性方面面临的重大障碍，可为促进该群体金融包容性、改善其经济状况的政策制定提供参考。

title: 글로벌 혁신 네트워크 참여의 경제적 함의와 통상 정책방향 연구(A Study on the Economic Implications of Participation in the Global Innovation Network and Trade Policy Directions)
title_zh: 全球创新网络参与的经济含义与贸易政策方向研究
title_primary: 全球创新网络参与的经济含义与贸易政策方向研究
title_secondary: 글로벌 혁신 네트워크 참여의 경제적 함의와 통상 정책방향 연구(A Study on the Economic Implications of Participation in the Global Innovation Network and Trade Policy Directions)
authors: Jong Duk Kim, Gusang Kang, Wonseok Choi, Hyunjin Lee, Jun Hyun Eom 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: With the rise of new industries, often new jobs emerge. Evolutionary Economic Geography and in particular Industry Life Cycle perspectives predict that these activities first emerge in a limited number of cities to then diffuse to other locations as job descriptions become more standardized. Here, we focus on a particularly important new industry: software development, an activity that is economically important, quickly changing, and has a pronounced spatial concentration in a small number of global IT hubs. We use an online database of over 60 million questions and answers about problems in software development that yields a longitudinal dataset of 237 software skills. By geo-locating 3 million posting users at regular intervals, we link these skills to cities worldwide. We find that, in spite of its digital nature, the software industry exhibits similar spatial regularities as previously observed in more traditional sectors. First, cities diversify into skills that are related to their existing ones. Second, new skills first emerge in cities with large and diversified software sectors, and later diffuse -- mostly unhindered by geographical distance -- to smaller cities specialized in closely related skills. We find suggestive but limited support for a windows of locational opportunity account: although even brand-new skills still emerge first in cities with strong prior specialization in related skills, concentrations of related activities impact less the emergence of new skills than the diffusion of existing ones.
abstract_zh: 本研究从“国家-产业间网络”视角审视新知识（创新）的创造现状，并分析了参与“创新网络”的经济含义。迄今为止，政策制定者在推动技术发展、强化创新能力时，通常侧重于增加本国研发投资总额。然而，在现代社会中，创新无法仅凭单一国家、产业或企业自身的研发实现。创新不仅在一国内部，更跨越国界，从其他国家、其他产业通过多种渠道共享与传播至另一国家或产业，因此政策制定必须充分考虑这一点。尤其对韩国而言，网络的重要性需要再次强调。

title: When finance meets entrepreneurial behaviour: explaining young firms’ survival and growth
title_zh: 金融与创业行为的交汇：解释年轻企业的生存与增长
title_primary: 金融与创业行为的交汇：解释年轻企业的生存与增长
title_secondary: When finance meets entrepreneurial behaviour: explaining young firms’ survival and growth
authors: Jean Bonnet, Nicolas Le Pape
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates how the interaction between financial structure and market strategy influences the survival and growth trajectories of young firms. We develop a theoretical model grounded in industrial organization showing that debt, through the limited liability mechanism, induces more aggressive market strategies and also increases the risk of failure. The model’s predictions are then tested using longitudinal data from the French SINE survey. While debt alone increases the risk of exit, a non-monotonic relationship exists regarding strategy: the highest proportion of aggressive firms is found among those with medium debt intensity. In this group, entrepreneurial behaviour (proactiveness and competitive aggressiveness) has a positive and significant effect on firm survival and, among surviving firms, increases the probability of belonging to the high-growth category. Entrepreneurial behaviour benefits only materialize when firms operate with a balanced financial structure combining debt and equity. High leverage increases the risk of failure, which cancels out the benefits of an aggressive market strategy. One possible explanation is that firms benefiting from a diversified range of financing sources (debt and equity) face fewer constraints in securing inputs. Improved bargaining power vis-à-vis suppliers may also enable them to better manage uncertainty in production costs.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了金融结构与市场策略之间的相互作用如何影响年轻企业的生存与成长轨迹。我们构建了一个基于产业组织理论的理论模型，表明债务通过有限责任机制，促使企业采取更具攻击性的市场策略，同时也增加了失败的风险。随后，我们利用法国SINE调查的纵向数据对模型的预测进行了检验。尽管债务单独增加了退出风险，但在策略方面存在非单调关系：中等债务强度的企业中，采取攻击性策略的比例最高。在这一群体中，企业家行为（主动性和竞争攻击性）对企业生存具有正向且显著的影响，并且在存活企业中，增加了进入高成长类别的概率。企业家行为的益处仅在企业在结合债务与股权的平衡财务结构下运营时才能实现。高杠杆增加了失败风险，这抵消了攻击性市场策略的益处。一个可能的解释是，受益于多样化融资来源（债务与股权）的企业在获取投入品方面面临更少的约束。与供应商相比，更强的议价能力也可能使它们更好地管理生产成本的不确定性。

title: The Biofuels Blueprint: Understanding the U.S. Renewable Fuel Standard
title_zh: 生物燃料蓝图：理解美国可再生燃料标准
title_primary: 生物燃料蓝图：理解美国可再生燃料标准
title_secondary: The Biofuels Blueprint: Understanding the U.S. Renewable Fuel Standard
authors: Maria Gerveni, Todd Hubbs, Scott H. Irwin, James H. Stock
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We provide a comprehensive review of the U.S. Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS), synthesizing nearly two decades of program evolution, market outcomes, and economic analysis. The RFS mandates minimum volumes of renewable fuel blending through a nested structure based on life‐cycle greenhouse gas reductions, enforced via tradeable Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs). Actual implementation diverged substantially from statutory targets, reaching only 20 billion gallons in 2022 versus the intended 36 billion, primarily due to failure to scale cellulosic biofuel production. RIN prices exhibit extraordinary volatility but follow rational economic fundamentals. Total inflation‐adjusted compliance costs are estimated to be $252.1 billion over 2011 through 2025.
abstract_zh: 本文全面回顾了美国可再生燃料标准（RFS），综合梳理了近二十年的政策演变、市场结果及经济分析。RFS通过基于生命周期温室气体减排量的嵌套结构，强制规定最低可再生燃料掺混量，并借助可交易的可再生识别码（RINs）执行。实际执行情况与法定目标存在显著偏差，2022年仅达到200亿加仑，远低于预期的360亿加仑，主要原因是纤维素生物燃料生产未能实现规模化。RIN价格表现出异常波动性，但遵循理性的经济基本面。经通胀调整后，2011年至2025年间的总合规成本估计为2521亿美元。

title: The economic consequences of cultural diversity in political organizations
title_zh: 政治组织中文化多样性的经济后果
title_primary: 政治组织中文化多样性的经济后果
title_secondary: The economic consequences of cultural diversity in political organizations
authors: Jiale Yan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I study the economic consequences of cultural diversity within political organizations. Using manually collected data on 25,568 members of county-level standing committees of the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese Industrial Enterprise Database from 1998 to 2013, I find that cultural diversity in county standing committees significantly reduces industrial output. I further identify potential mechanisms: greater committee diversity is associated with lower government and capital construction spending, slower and weaker responses to public appeals, and lower labor and capital inputs as well as enterprise investment. Moreover, counties with more culturally diverse standing committees exhibit lower nighttime light intensity and reduced per capita GDP. Overall, these results highlight a potential limitation of China’s current political organizational structure and institutional arrangements.
abstract_zh: 我研究了政治组织内部文化多样性的经济后果。基于手动收集的1998年至2013年间中国共产党县级常务委员会25568名成员数据及中国工业企业数据库，发现县级常委会的文化多样性显著降低了工业产出。进一步识别出潜在机制：委员会多样性程度越高，政府与基建支出越低，对公众诉求的响应速度与力度越弱，劳动与资本投入及企业投资也相应减少。此外，文化多样性更高的县级常委会所在地区，夜间灯光强度与人均GDP均有所下降。总体而言，这些结果揭示了中国现行政治组织结构与制度安排可能存在的局限性。

title: Composite driving mechanisms of farmland abandonment in plains and mountainous areas of China from a 1-km grid perspective
title_zh: 1公里网格视角下中国平原与山区耕地撂荒的复合驱动机制
title_primary: 1公里网格视角下中国平原与山区耕地撂荒的复合驱动机制
title_secondary: Composite driving mechanisms of farmland abandonment in plains and mountainous areas of China from a 1-km grid perspective
authors: Jiayi Jiang, Sijing Ye, Longfeng Weng, Guoli Wang, Shuyi Ren 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Reducing farmland abandonment is essential for protecting farmland resources and ensuring national food security. The driving mechanisms of farmland abandonment in China at the 1-km grid scale remain insufficiently understood. In this study, a composite theoretical framework integrating natural factors, socioeconomic factors, and cultivation conditions was developed to explain farmland abandonment at the grid scale. Fifteen driving variables, together with a 1-km gridded dataset of farmland abandonment ratio (the proportion of abandoned farmland relative to the total farmland area), were modelled using random forest models. The SHAPley additive explanations algorithm was applied to quantify both the individual effects and interaction effects. The results revealed that in 2019, the overall farmland abandonment ratio in China was 4.49%, with higher rates observed in mountainous areas (6.26%) than in the plains (2.22%). Stable hotspots of farmland abandonment emerged in the agro‑pastoral transition zone between the northern arid and semiarid regions and the Loess Plateau, in the southeastern coastal region, in the southwestern mountainous region, and around the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei urban agglomeration. Distinct driving mechanisms of farmland abandonment were observed between plains and mountainous areas. Increased farmland density mitigated abandonment risk across both terrains by strengthening large‑scale farming and organizational structure. In plains, farmland abandonment was governed mainly by labour, location, and organizational structure. Engineering improvements and institutional support weakened the effects of climatic and topographic factors. The influence of ageing was both stage-specific and bidirectional. In mountainous areas, farmland abandonment was driven mainly by strong coupling among climatic conditions, topography, and service accessibility. The effects of climatic conditions were amplified by their interactions with slope and altitude, resulting in the formation of a chain that extends from natural stress to mechanization constraints and ultimately to cost accumulation. The dominant driving factors of farmland abandonment varied regionally. Natural factors dominated in western high‑altitude, cold, and arid areas. Socioeconomic factors dominated in the plains and rapidly urbanizing regions. Cultivation conditions were dominant in hilly regions and areas characterized by fragmented farmland. This study enhances the understanding of farmland abandonment from a grid-scale perspective and provides guidance for regionalized governance strategies.
abstract_zh: 减少农田撂荒对于保护耕地资源和保障国家粮食安全至关重要。然而，在中国1公里网格尺度上，农田撂荒的驱动机制仍未得到充分理解。本研究构建了一个整合自然因素、社会经济因素和耕作条件的综合理论框架，以解释网格尺度下的农田撂荒现象。利用随机森林模型，对十五个驱动变量及一套1公里网格化的农田撂荒率（撂荒农田占农田总面积的比例）数据集进行了建模。采用SHAPley加性解释算法量化了各变量的独立效应及其交互效应。研究结果显示，2019年中国整体农田撂荒率为4.49%，山区（6.26%）显著高于平原地区（2.22%）。农田撂荒的稳定热点区域出现在北方干旱半干旱区与黄土高原之间的农牧交错带、东南沿海地区、西南山区以及京津冀城市群周边。平原与山区的农田撂荒驱动机制存在显著差异。农田密度的增加通过强化规模化经营和组织结构，在两种地形条件下均降低了撂荒风险。在平原地区，农田撂荒主要受劳动力、区位和组织结构因素支配。工程改善和制度支持削弱了气候和地形因素的影响。老龄化的影响具有阶段性和双向性特征。在山区，农田撂荒主要由气候条件、地形和服务可及性之间的强耦合作用驱动。气候条件的影响通过与坡度和海拔的交互作用被放大，形成了从自然胁迫到机械化约束、最终到成本累积的连锁链条。农田撂荒的主导驱动因素存在区域差异。自然因素在西部高海拔、寒冷和干旱地区占主导地位。社会经济因素在平原和快速城市化地区占主导地位。耕作条件在丘陵地区和农田破碎化区域占主导地位。本研究从网格尺度深化了对农田撂荒的理解，并为分区治理策略提供了指导。

title: Air pollution and consumers’ avoidance behavior: Evidence from high-frequency payment data in China
title_zh: 空气污染与消费者规避行为：来自中国高频支付数据的证据
title_primary: 空气污染与消费者规避行为：来自中国高频支付数据的证据
title_secondary: Air pollution and consumers’ avoidance behavior: Evidence from high-frequency payment data in China
authors: Haiqiang Chen, Shihe Fu, Zhuoyang Lyu
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper estimates the impact of air pollution on consumers’ offline consumption behavior using high-frequency, bankcard transaction-level payment data from China in 2015 and 2016. Employing a panel regression approach with thermal inversion as the instrumental variable for daily local air pollution exposure, we find a statistically and economically significant, negative relationship between pollution exposure and consumer spending. On average, a 100 μg/m3 increase in daily PM2.5 concentration leads to a 14% reduction in daily offline consumer expenditures paid via bankcards. The adverse impacts are particularly pronounced for spending on deferrable goods, groceries, and daily life services; and consumers significantly reduce outdoor shopping activities—including travel distance to intra-city shopping venues—during periods of elevated pollution, consistent with avoidance behavior. Older individuals, high-spending consumers, and holiday shoppers exhibit stronger response to pollution. Our findings underscore the potential economic co-benefits, in terms of consumption, achievable through policies improving air quality.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国2015年至2016年高频银行卡交易层面的支付数据，估计了空气污染对消费者线下消费行为的影响。采用面板回归方法，并以热逆温作为每日局部空气污染暴露的工具变量，我们发现污染暴露与消费者支出之间存在统计显著且经济意义显著的负相关关系。平均而言，每日PM2.5浓度每增加100微克/立方米，会导致通过银行卡支付的线下日常消费支出减少14%。这一不利影响在可延迟商品、食品杂货及日常生活服务类支出中尤为突出；同时，在污染加剧期间，消费者显著减少户外购物活动——包括前往市内购物场所的出行距离，这与规避行为相一致。老年人、高消费群体及节假日购物者对污染的反应更为强烈。我们的研究结果强调了通过改善空气质量的政策在消费方面可能实现的潜在经济协同效益。

title: Preferences for Sustainable Production Practices in Extensive Livestock Systems in Uruguay
title_zh: 乌拉圭粗放型畜牧系统中可持续生产实践的偏好
title_primary: 乌拉圭粗放型畜牧系统中可持续生产实践的偏好
title_secondary: Preferences for Sustainable Production Practices in Extensive Livestock Systems in Uruguay
authors: Santiago Guerrero, Laure Kuhfuss, José Ignacio Rivero‐Wildemauwe, Patricia Correa, Miguel Carriquiry, Francisco Rosas, José Velazco
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We use a discrete choice experiment along with behavioral measures of risk and time preferences to analyze the preferences of Uruguayan cattle producers for three types of sustainable livestock practices: improved grazing systems, sustainable livestock management, and silvopastoral approaches. The results indicate that, on average, producers favor sustainable intensification, are indifferent to improved grazing practices, and require monetary compensation to adopt silvopastoral systems. A latent class model reveals significant preference heterogeneity, identifying two distinct producer profiles: one inclined to adopt the proposed practices and another that requires stronger incentives. These findings underscore the importance of designing differentiated policy instruments tailored to the characteristics and motivations of diverse producer types.
abstract_zh: 我们采用离散选择实验，并结合风险与时间偏好的行为度量，分析了乌拉圭养牛生产者对三类可持续畜牧业实践——改良放牧系统、可持续畜牧管理及林牧复合系统——的偏好。结果显示，平均而言，生产者倾向于可持续集约化，对改良放牧实践持中立态度，而采纳林牧复合系统则需要经济补偿。潜在类别模型揭示了显著的偏好异质性，识别出两类不同的生产者特征：一类倾向于采纳所提议的实践，另一类则需要更强的激励措施。这些发现强调了设计差异化政策工具的重要性，以适应不同生产者类型的特征与动机。

title: Harnessing Social Information to Improve Public Support for Pigouvian Taxes
title_zh: 利用社会信息提升公众对庇古税的支持
title_primary: 利用社会信息提升公众对庇古税的支持
title_secondary: Harnessing Social Information to Improve Public Support for Pigouvian Taxes
authors: Marion Dupoux, Benjamin Ouvrard
official: 官方在线 2026-05-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Pigouvian taxes are often unpopular among the general public. We test the effectiveness of pro-tax social information in increasing support for such taxes. In a lab experiment that involves a market game with externalities, we provide subjects with information about other participants’ views about the “right thing to do” (voting, or not, for the tax policy). We also elicit personal, normative, and positive beliefs. Our findings demonstrate a causal effect of social information provision on subjects’ support for the tax, and that subjects’ changes in beliefs is a causal mechanism through which this increased support for the tax is made possible. We therefore highlight the important role of beliefs in voting behaviors and the acceptability of Pigouvian taxes.
abstract_zh: 庇古税在公众中往往不受欢迎。我们通过实验检验了支持税收的社会信息在提升此类税收支持度方面的有效性。在一个涉及外部性的市场博弈实验室实验中，我们向受试者提供了关于其他参与者对“正确做法”（即是否投票支持税收政策）看法的信息。同时，我们也收集了个人信念、规范性信念和实证性信念。研究结果显示，社会信息的提供对受试者支持税收产生了因果效应，并且受试者信念的变化是实现这一税收支持度提升的因果机制。因此，我们强调了信念在投票行为及庇古税可接受性中的重要作用。

title: Assessing Household Welfare in Response to Rising Food Prices in The Gambia
title_zh: 评估冈比亚食品价格上涨对家庭福利的影响
title_primary: 评估冈比亚食品价格上涨对家庭福利的影响
title_secondary: Assessing Household Welfare in Response to Rising Food Prices in The Gambia
authors: Roger Vorsah, Obed Quaicoe, Fafanyo Asiseh, John N. Ng'ombe
official: 官方在线 2026-05-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how rising food prices affected household welfare in The Gambia using nationally representative data from the 2015/16 Integrated Household Survey (IHS‐3). The analysis reflects household consumption behavior and market conditions prevailing during that period and provides a structural benchmark for understanding vulnerability in an import‐dependent economy. Using data from 5443 households, we estimate price and expenditure elasticities for four key food groups—cereals, animal products, roots and tubers, and fruits and vegetables through a censored Quadratic Almost Ideal Demand System (QUAIDS) model that accounts for zero consumption and nonlinear expenditure effects. Results reveal substantial heterogeneity across income groups and geographic locations. Poor urban households are most vulnerable to food price increases due to greater market dependence and limited substitution options, while rural households are particularly sensitive to cereal price shocks. Compensating variation estimates indicate that poor urban households require significantly higher income compensation to maintain welfare following price increases. Although structural conditions have evolved since 2015, the findings provide baseline evidence on household demand responses and distributional impacts of food price shocks in The Gambia.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用冈比亚2015/16年度综合住户调查（IHS-3）的全国代表性数据，考察粮食价格上涨对家庭福利的影响。分析反映了该时期家庭消费行为与市场状况，为理解进口依赖型经济体的脆弱性提供了结构性基准。基于5443户家庭数据，我们通过考虑零消费和非线性支出效应的删失二次近乎理想需求系统（QUAIDS）模型，估算了四大关键食品类别（谷物、动物产品、块根块茎类、果蔬）的价格弹性与支出弹性。结果显示，不同收入群体和地理区域存在显著异质性。城市贫困家庭因市场依赖度更高且替代选择有限，对粮食价格上涨最为脆弱；而农村家庭对谷物价格冲击尤为敏感。补偿变分估计表明，价格上涨后，城市贫困家庭需获得显著更高的收入补偿才能维持原有福利水平。尽管2015年以来结构性条件已发生变化，但本研究为冈比亚家庭需求响应及粮食价格冲击的分配效应提供了基线证据。
